tests.name: Execute shell script via python's command mode arguement
tests.description: Download and execute shell script and write to file then execute locally using Python -c (command mode)

tests.name: Execute Python via scripts
tests.description: Create Python file (.py) that downloads and executes shell script via executor arguments

tests.name: Execute Python via Python executables
tests.description: Create Python file (.py) then compile to binary (.pyc) that downloads an external malicious script then executes locally using the supplied executor and arguments

tests.name: Python pty module and spawn function used to spawn sh or bash
tests.description: Uses the Python spawn function to spawn a sh shell followed by a bash shell. Per Volexity, this technique was observed in exploitation of Atlassian Confluence [CVE-2022-26134]. Reference: https://www.volexity.com/blog/2022/06/02/zero-day-exploitation-of-atlassian-confluence
